answer_1.quote: We propose a new approach named SCENE (Self-labeled Counterfactuals for Extrapolating to Negative Examples) to automatically generate subtly negative examples given a dataset of only positive examples.
answer_1.outputs: synthetic negative examples such as unanswerable questions or non-entailment pairs

answer_2.quote: The best SCENE method achieves 71.8 F1, which closes 69.6% of the gap in SQuAD 2.0 accuracy between the baseline that trains on SQuAD 1.1 (45.7 F1) and the oracle method that trains on SQuAD 2.0 (83.2 F1).
